Name: Really Heavy Sebby
Author: Pixel3r
Description:
Now in v1.0!

Someone pointed out that the Motorcycle Ride event lacked our beloved blubbery bachelor, so I tracked down the stray sprites involved in that event, and edited them~ FYI, they were found in LooseSprites/Cursor.xnb, which houses a lot of other generic sprites, so it may conflict with general graphical mods.

Esasia's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/277/?]Heavy Sebby Mod[/url] was good, but I wanted Bigger.
This is my own, entirely custom spritesheet for Sebastian, to be a very large young man.
It also includes replacing his smoking habit with way too many sodas.
The zip is already in the proper file tree, so just extract it, and merge the Content folder with your Stardew Valley folder.
